card.name: Verbs of putting contents somewhere
card.fires_on: Action verbs like empty, pour, paste, type or spit that are followed by a thing and a destination. It appears in step-by-step instructions, such as emptying capsule granules onto food.

modes.label: Emptying or pouring contents
modes.description: Verbs for moving contents out of a capsule or packet onto or into something.

modes.label: Typing or pasting text
modes.description: Computer instruction verbs for entering text into a box or reader.
modes.example: 2.<< Paste>> the URL into your reader.

card.writes: It favors words like onto and into, which suggests the next word is a destination for the thing moved.
card.plain: It spots verbs like empty, pour or paste that are about to say where something goes.
